visual.general_description: Line chart of hemoglobin (g/L) over time for the first and second hospitalizations, with two unlabeled arrows.
visual.detailed_description: Line chart with a legend at the top: blue squares for First hospitalization and orange circles for Second hospitalization. The y-axis is HB (g/L) from 70 to 140 in steps of 10; the x-axis is Time(days) with labels on admission, after surgery, 1 to 15 (every day printed) and 3 months later. The blue first-hospitalization line starts near 122 on admission, falls to about 107 after surgery and 104 on day 1, about 90 on day 2, a minimum of about 74 on day 4, about 82 on day 5 and 79 on day 6, then rises to about 95 on day 7, 100 on days 8 and 10, 113 on day 15 and about 121 at 3 months later. The orange second-hospitalization line starts near 132 on admission, falls to about 97 after surgery, 99 on day 1, 91 on day 2, 86 on day 4, 82 on days 7 and 8, about 80 on day 10, 84 on day 13, then rises steeply to about 136 at 3 months later. Two unlabeled dark arrows are drawn near the x-axis: a downward arrow pointing at the blue day 4 minimum and an upward arrow below the blue day 6 point. No arrow legend, patient names or panel letters are present.
